{{External|rs|rsc=Cook's Range}} {{Infobox Scenery |name = Cooking range |image = [[File:Cooking range (Lumbridge Castle).png|250px]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = [[Cook's Assistant]] |location = [[Lumbridge Castle]] |options = Cook |examine = An appliance for cooking with. |map = {{Map|x=3212|y=3215|plane=0|r=2|mapID=0|mtype=square}} |id = 114 }} This '''Cooking range''', referred to as the '''Cook-o-matic 100''' by the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Lumbridge Cook]] (more commonly referred to as the '''Lumbridge Castle Range''' or simply the '''Cook's range''') is a special [[cooking range|range]], located in the kitchen, on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the [[Lumbridge Castle]]. It is notable as it improves the chances of cooking certain foods, especially [[mushroom pie|mushroom]] and [[botanical pie]]s. This makes it particularly helpful for players without access to other special cooking ranges, or a [[cooking cape]]. But only those who have completed the [[Cook's Assistant]] quest may use it. If one tries before then, the cook will stop them. ==Burn level== {{Main|Cooking/Burn level}} The range can reduce the burn chance of the following foods: {| class="wikitable sortable align-left-2" style="text-align:center;" ! rowspan="2" colspan="2" |Food ! rowspan="2" |[[Cooking]]
